facts.en: Completed a digital communication diploma at Fictional Pineorbit Institute in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构松轨学院完成数字传播文凭课程。

facts.en: Completed an internal mailing-platform orientation in 2023-03; it was not a vendor certification.
facts.zh: 2023-03 完成内部邮件平台入门培训；并非厂商认证。

facts.en: Content scheduling assistant at Fictional Ribbon Bulletin, 2021-10 to 2023-08.
facts.zh: 2021-10 至 2023-08 在虚构缎带简报机构任内容排期助理。

facts.en: Email operations coordinator at Fictional Ribbon Bulletin, 2023-09 to 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2023-09 至 2026-09 在虚构缎带简报机构任电子邮件运营协调员。

facts.en: Builds approved newsletter layouts and checks links before the marketing lead authorizes sending.
facts.zh: 制作经批准的简报版式，并在营销负责人授权发送前检查链接。

facts.en: Supported two separate newsletter sends in 2025-06 and 2025-07; the team changed both content and audience selection.
facts.zh: 支持 2025-06 及 2025-07 两次独立简报发送；团队同时调整了内容及受众选择。

facts.en: The 2025-06 send recorded 40 unique clicking recipients among 1000 delivered emails, a 4% unique-recipient click rate.
facts.zh: 2025-06 发送在 1000 封已投递邮件中记录 40 名独立点击收件人，独立收件人点击率为 4%。

facts.en: The 2025-07 send recorded 60 unique clicking recipients among 1000 delivered emails, a 6% unique-recipient click rate.
facts.zh: 2025-07 发送在 1000 封已投递邮件中记录 60 名独立点击收件人，独立收件人点击率为 6%。

facts.en: The observed difference is 2 percentage points, or 50% relative to the earlier rate; the sends were not a randomized test.
facts.zh: 观察到的差值为 2 个百分点，或相对于先前点击率的 50%；两次发送不是随机试验。

facts.en: Personally checked destination links and exported the campaign report; the lead selected copy and audience criteria.
facts.zh: 个人检查目标链接并导出活动报告；文案及受众标准由负责人选择。

facts.en: Uses mailing-platform previews, campaign tags, and spreadsheet rate calculations.
facts.zh: 使用邮件平台预览、活动标签及电子表格比率计算。

facts.en: Drafted a subject-line experiment plan in 2026-04; it had not been executed by 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2026-04 起草主题行实验计划；截至 2026-09 尚未执行。

facts.en: Applies approved suppression lists before requesting send approval; does not set consent policy.
facts.zh: 在申请发送批准前应用经批准的抑制名单；不制定同意政策。

facts.en: Created a personal illustrated calendar with 12 invented festival scenes in 2024.
facts.zh: 2024 年制作含 12 个虚构节庆场景的个人插画日历。

facts.en: Enjoys sketching and playing a small hand drum.
facts.zh: 爱好素描及演奏小手鼓。

facts.en: No campaign-attributed revenue measurement or randomized-test result is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录归因于活动的收入测量或随机试验结果。
